verdict.rationale: Consensus offers an API for integrating its search into custom workflows and running automated searches (consensus-docs-1, consensus-docs-15), which implies some programmatic/headless usability. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI integration, headless execution modes, CLI tooling, or automation pipeline examples. Missing for 10: CI/CD integration examples, headless mode documentation, CLI or SDK for automation, and independent evidence of running in automated pipelines.
